metadata.description: Student records, checks and school documents in one place.

common.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.
common.notConnected: This screen is not connected to the server yet. Nothing was saved.
common.scrollableTable: {caption}. Scroll sideways to see all columns.
common.notAvailableYetBody: This part of SchoolOS is still being set up. Check again later.

home.title: Home
home.description: Your school's work at a glance.
home.cardHint: Appears once your student records are imported.
home.gettingStartedBody: Set up your academic years, classes and sections first. Then invite your office staff.

structure.title: School structure
structure.description: Set up academic years, classes and sections. Records, registers and reports use this structure.

years.title: Academic years
years.emptyBody: Add the current academic year, for example 2026-27, to get started.

classes.title: Classes
classes.emptyBody: Add classes from Nursery to Class XII, the way your school runs them.

sections.title: Sections
sections.emptyBody: Add sections such as A, B and C to each class.

users.title: Users and roles
users.description: Invite staff, give them roles and choose which classes they can see.
users.emptyBody: Invite the principal and office staff first. Each person signs in with their own account.
users.rolesDescription: Each role gives a set of permissions. Changes take effect within a minute and are recorded in the audit log.

billing.title: Plan and billing
billing.description: Your current plan, how much of it you are using, and your invoices.
billing.planUnavailable: Plan details are not available right now.
billing.changePlanHint: To change your plan, contact SchoolOS support.
billing.emptyBody: Invoices appear here each month once your subscription is active.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: See who changed or viewed important records, and when.
audit.emptyBody: Try a wider date range or clear the filters.

platform.noStudentData: Student records are never shown in the platform admin panel.

dashboard.title: Platform dashboard
dashboard.description: Revenue, schools and fleet health across SchoolOS.

schools.title: Schools
schools.description: Every school on SchoolOS, with its plan, status and deployment.
schools.searchHint: Search by school name or code.
schools.emptyBody: Provision the first school to create its tenant, encryption key and owner invite.

schoolDetail.title: School details
schoolDetail.offboardNote: Offboarding needs a second operator's approval. The school's data is exported, then deleted within 30 days.
schoolDetail.suspendDialogBody: Staff will not be able to sign in until the school is reactivated. Records are kept.
schoolDetail.emptyBody: Details appear here once this school is connected.

provision.title: Provision school
provision.description: Create a new school with its own encryption key, default roles and an owner invite.

fields.schoolNameHint: The name staff and parents know the school by.
fields.noPlans: No plans are available yet. Create one in Plans and pricing first.
fields.sharedHint: Runs on the shared SchoolOS platform in Mumbai. Suits most schools.
fields.dedicatedHint: One isolated server for this school, with its own storage and keys.
fields.customDomainHint: Dedicated deployments only, for example office.school.edu.in.
fields.ownerHint: The owner gets an invite to set up their account with two-step sign-in.

provision.reviewIntro: Check these details before you provision the school.
provision.errorSummary: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}
provision.notConnected: Provisioning is not connected yet. Nothing was created.

validation.tooLong: This is too long. Shorten it and try again.
validation.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.invalidStateCode: Enter the two-digit state code, for example 37.
validation.invalidDomain: Enter a domain like office.school.edu.in, without https://.
validation.domainNeedsDedicated: Custom domains are only available for dedicated deployments.
validation.bothLanguages: Write this in both English and Telugu.

plans.title: Plans and pricing
plans.description: Plans are versioned. Prices are in rupees and do not include 18% GST.
plans.emptyBody: Create a plan version with prices and limits before provisioning schools.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Trials, active and past-due subscriptions. Change a school's plan from here.
subscriptions.emptyBody: A subscription is created when you provision a school.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Monthly drafts are created automatically. Issue them, mark them paid or void them here.
invoices.numberingNote: Numbers follow the financial year, for example SOS/2026-27/000123.
invoices.manualPaymentNote: Bank transfers and UPI payments are marked paid by a billing admin.
invoices.emptyBody: Draft invoices are created on the first day of each month for active subscriptions.

usage.title: Usage and quotas
usage.description: Daily totals for each school. Alerts go out at 80% and 100% of plan limits. Counts only, never personal data.
usage.emptyBody: Usage totals appear the day after a school starts using SchoolOS.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for everyone, for a percentage of schools, or for specific schools.
flags.emptyBody: Create a flag to release a feature gradually.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Shared and dedicated deployments, their versions and last heartbeat. Heartbeats carry version, health and counts only.
fleet.emptyBody: A deployment record is created when you provision a school.
fleet.versionsEmptyBody: Versions appear after deployments send their first heartbeat.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Banners shown to school staff, in English and Telugu.
announcements.bothLanguagesHint: Write the title and message in both English and Telugu before saving.

support.title: Support tickets
support.description: Tickets opened by schools. Reply before the SLA time shown on each ticket.
support.piiWarningTitle: Do not include student personal data
support.piiWarningBody: Never paste student names, dates of birth, Aadhaar details, phone numbers or photos into tickets or replies. Refer to records by their ID instead.
support.emptyBody: Tickets opened by schools appear here.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass requests
breakGlass.description: Temporary support access to a school. The school's principal must approve it, and access ends automatically.
breakGlass.emptyBody: Requests for temporary access to a school appear here.

operators.title: Operators and roles
operators.description: People who run SchoolOS. Every operator must use two-step sign-in.
operators.stepUpNote: You will be asked to confirm with two-step sign-in.
operators.emptyBody: Invite the people who run billing, support and deployments.

audit.title: Platform audit log
audit.description: Every operator action, recorded in a tamper-evident chain.
audit.emptyBody: Operator actions such as provisioning and plan changes appear here.

errors.notFoundBody: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

load.forbidden: You don't have access to this. Ask your school's office admin if you need it.
load.active_tenant_required: You work in more than one school. Choose the school first, then open this page again.
load.mfa_required: Your role needs two-step verification (MFA). Set it up, then sign in again.
load.tenant_suspended: This school's access is paused. The owner can contact SchoolOS support.

auth.lockNowHint: Sign out at once so no one else can use this computer as you.
auth.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Check your internet connection, then try again.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: To keep school records safe on shared computers, you will be signed out in about 1 minute.

signedOut.title: You are signed out
signedOut.body: If this is a shared computer, close the browser when you are done.
signedOut.idle: You were signed out because this computer was not used for a while.
signedOut.signIn: Sign in to the school office
signedOut.platformSignIn: Sign in to the platform admin panel

errors.signin_expired: Signing in took too long. Sign in again.
errors.signin_failed: We couldn't sign you in. Sign in again. If it keeps happening, contact your school's office admin.
errors.signin_unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.mfa_required: Your account needs two-step verification (MFA). Set it up, then sign in again.
errors.step_up_failed: We couldn't confirm it's you. Sign in again to continue.
